author: claude-chat
title: SESSION HANDOUT v3 - paste as the first message of a new claude-chat session. Rewritten 20 Aug end of session. Supersedes v1 and v2.
body:
*** FIRST ACTION - CLONE ALL SEVEN REPOSITORIES INTO YOUR CONTAINER: ***
  cd /home/claude && rm -rf repos && mkdir -p repos && cd repos
  for r in compliance-tracker projexa veridian-ui-kit veda-advisors claude-control \
           zai-independent-audit-2026-07-30 zai-sap-reports-queue; do
    git clone --depth 50 https://github.com/FChecklist/$r.git
  done
All seven are PUBLIC; github.com is on your egress allowlist. No credential needed or wanted.
The container RESETS between sessions, so this runs EVERY time.
*** GREP ALL SEVEN, NEVER ONE. This is a TWO-REPOSITORY PRODUCT: VERIDIAN backend in
compliance-tracker, screens and reports in projexa. Chat once declared two requirements
unbuilt after searching one repo; both were built in projexa (E-112). A claim of absence
that does not state its search scope is not evidence. ***
RECORD THE COMMIT SHA WITH EVERY MEASURED FACT (E-83).

SUPABASE: pcrjmlpuqsbocqfwoxod  = VERIDIAN. All notes, the queue and the compliance schema.
          evpckeuxgvahguwsaeul  = PROJEXA's OWN database, 11 public tables. TWO DIFFERENT
          PROJECTS (E-46). Applying a migration to the wrong one is the easiest catastrophic
          mistake available here.
GOOGLE DRIVE IS READ-ONLY (M15). Read from it; never create, write, move or trash anything.

================================================================================
=== THE WORK IS ALL IN ONE TABLE. START HERE.
================================================================================
*** platform.cc_spec IS THE SINGLE SHARED WORKSHEET BETWEEN CHAT AND CLAUDE CODE.
IT SURVIVES EVERY CHAT AND EVERY RUNNER SESSION. THERE IS NO SECOND QUEUE. ***
Point numbering is continuous and never restarts. Highest point today: 202.

  select what_to_do from platform.cc_spec where point_no = 0;   -- THE PROTOCOL. Not a task.
  select * from platform.cc_queue;                              -- what the runner may work now

STATE AT CLOSE, 22 AUG:
  202 points total. 58 closed. 62 open.
  *** ALL 62 OPEN POINTS ARE spec_ready. ZERO UNSPECCED. The contract-writing backlog that
  blocked this engagement for four audits is FINISHED. ***
  Of the 62 open: 18 in cc_queue and runnable now | 22 BLOCKED-STACK (need a running app)
  | 5 BLOCKED-RAJAT | 2 BLOCKED-SUMEET | 13 CHAT-owned.
  error_log runs to E-115. Requirements: 69 rows, 11 fully proven.

EVERY OPEN POINT ALREADY CARRIES: acceptance criteria, three gates, a MEASURED baseline with
real line numbers and row counts, exact file paths, a do_not_assume list of traps already
paid for, and a closure proof. DO NOT REWRITE THEM. Read the row and work it.

================================================================================
=== WHAT CLAUDE CODE DOES, AND HOW
================================================================================
 1. select * from platform.cc_queue  -> take the LOWEST read_order.
 2. CLAIM: cc_status='IN_PROGRESS - <run>', run_id, heartbeat_at, started_at.
 3. AUDIT BEFORE (run gate1) -> DO THE WORK -> AUDIT AFTER -> THREE GATES, each boolean.
 4. WRITE BACK to that row only, with proof_of_work as RAW MACHINE OUTPUT, never a summary.
 5. Three attempts with DIFFERENT logic, then 'FAILED-3 - <reason>' and MOVE ON.
    A network drop is NOT an attempt.
 6. NEVER set cc_closed or chat_verified. Only chat closes, after reproducing the proof.
*** BEFORE ANY WRITE: platform.cc_spec has RLS ENABLED and ZERO POLICIES. With a
non-bypassing role every write silently succeeds and changes nothing. Update heartbeat_at on
point 0, read it back, and STOP if it did not move. ***

ENVIRONMENT: run  test -d /work && echo CONTAINER || echo LAPTOP  first.
LAPTOP mode is current - the contract paths are already correct, translate nothing.
  compliance-tracker  C:\Users\Dell\Projects\compliance-tracker
  projexa             C:\Users\Dell\Downloads\Claude Code\projexa
  NEVER Downloads\Claude Code\compliance-tracker - 811 commits stale.
*** DO NOT SSH TO 167.233.220.35 AND DO NOT RUN DOCKER. A live hook, veridian-server-gate,
blocks it and is a SAFETY CONTROL. The runner correctly refused to route around it (E-115).
Nothing in the queue needs it. The Hetzner container plan is SUSPENDED. ***

================================================================================
=== THE ONE THING THAT BLOCKS THE MOST
================================================================================
E-97 / E-76: veridian-aios.com returns 500. Measured still live 22 Aug 03:59Z on production
deployment dpl_7WXXCbX1VHmejTRLYZQ8Y1NKFowJ @ 3e6f84b - SQLSTATE 28P01, password
authentication failed for user postgres. THE BUILD IS HEALTHY; ONLY THE RUNTIME CREDENTIAL
IS WRONG. It blocks the 22 BLOCKED-STACK points.
*** IT NEVER BLOCKED LOCAL TESTING AND CHAT WAS WRONG ABOUT THAT FOR TWO SESSIONS (M18).
next dev reads DATABASE_URL from the local env and projexa's VERIDIAN_API_BASE_URL is
overridable. Point 174 stands the local stack up. ***
SEQUENCE FOR THE FIX IS POINT 183 AND THE ORDER IS THE DELIVERABLE: merge the honest health
probe FIRST (else a third failure looks like success - M16), then the credential, then a
FRESH deploy not a Redeploy, then confirm health flips 503->200, then insert the missing
product_branches row for veridian-aios.com (E-108), then re-run the demo gate against
production. CHAT AND THE RUNNER MUST NOT SET THE CREDENTIAL (E-72).

================================================================================
=== OPEN FOR RAJAT - FOUR DECISIONS, EACH ROUGHLY A SENTENCE
================================================================================
 1. THE LAYOUT RULING. MOCK1.HTML says narrow-left; Rajat directed wide-middle on 16 AUG;
    veridian-ui-kit commit 8f692af then shipped "left working column, wide right ERP
    surface", which is neither. *** READ 8f692af FIRST - the ruling may already be moot. ***
    Blocks points 187, 169 and 188 - the entire two-screen workstream.
 2. MARGIN OR COST CEILING for the 25% budget figure. On item 1.01 at 50,976.00: ceiling
    gives 12,744.00, margin gives 38,232.00. A FACTOR OF THREE on every line, in a report he
    checks by hand. Blocks points 154 and 135. Acceptable dev-phase unblock: BOTH behind a
    config flag with the assumption recorded - never a silent choice.
 3. REPO VISIBILITY x2 AND THE GPLv3 REVIEW - point 180. All seven repos are PUBLIC (E-53),
    and veda-advisors has carried a populated DATABASE_URL in a committed .env since 28 JUNE
    (E-54). Making a repo private does NOT fix E-54 - git history persists; rotation does.
 4. DEFER THE CHAIN LAYER - point 122. 33 open phase-12 rows in the DEAD build_plan table
    (E-85). Chat recommends DEFER: no Sumeet module, report or demo-gate case needs it.
ALSO RAJAT: rotate the demo admin password (R-A1) and the live GitHub PAT (R-A2, E-30).
OPEN FOR SUMEET: the site instruction form, never seen (point 166).

================================================================================
=== HOW WE WORK - THE RULES THAT COST THE MOST TO LEARN
================================================================================
 1. Chat clones and reads source ITSELF; checks Supabase and Vercel ITSELF.
 2. CHAT WRITES THE CONTRACT, THE RUNNER WRITES THE IMPLEMENTATION (M20). The runner can
    code, fix, merge PRs and drive a browser. Chat pre-writes exact bytes only when they are
    already proven. Chat was the bottleneck for four audits by forgetting this.
 3. MEASURE BEFORE WRITING ANYTHING. Every batch of contracts found a premise error and NOT
    ONE was found by reading.
 4. spec_ready is generated - fourteen fields, three gates, a measured baseline. It cannot
    be faked. A gate that already passes must be labelled a WATCHDOG or it is decoration
    (E-89). Anchor greps to code, never to prose - a comment can contain the string (E-111).
    grep -c exits 1 on a zero count, so use ; not && between gate clauses.
 5. Chat VERIFIES from a source the runner did not produce, then closes. Never from the report.
 6. RUN THE EIGHT-CHECK AUDIT AS QUERIES BEFORE ANY HANDOVER (M22, point 184). Write the
    check before writing the claim. When Rajat says the plan is incomplete, it is.
 7. KEEP THE PUSHBACK LINE: "if a premise looks wrong, stop and say so." It has caught
    fifteen chat defects, including a gate that could never pass and a forbidden install that
    was the only possible fix.

=== FIFTEEN PREMISE ERRORS FOUND BY MEASUREMENT - DO NOT RE-TRUST A DESCRIPTION ===
R-15 and R-44 built in projexa while chat searched only compliance-tracker | R-40 blocked by
a missing WRITE PATH, not a wrong data model | E-29 understated its own numbers threefold |
E-52 overstated its scope, residue is 14 of 234 routes | photo table and bucket ordered
backwards | the migration ledger ALREADY REPAIRED at 293/293/293 | the nanoid CVE names a
repo that has no nanoid | R-61 verified on "one row per org" against 3 of 273 | R-B1 asks for
one Playwright test and 24 specs already exist | R-B2, the GO-LIVE GATE, excluded from chat's
own denominator as n/a | twelve duplicate points created and retired | 61 of 69 requirements
have NO test, so 100% was unreachable by construction until sumeet_uat gained a join.

=== THE ORACLE, recomputed by chat from his real workbook ===
Drive fileId 1rHcclwnz7kLeX-nrF3VAmCgQJVKn6Ouf. 33 roots | 120 sub-tasks | 6 headers |
root-only sum 420,250.00 EXACT | item 1.01 = 472.00 x 108.00 = 50,976.00 | Frame 01 at 30%
-> rate 32.40, amount 15,292.80 | 1.04 children sum to 75% and 4.02 to 65% - NEVER NORMALISE
| weighted cum qty 217.50 = 400x.30 + 300x.15 + 300x.10 + 150x.15 | cum amt 23,490.00 |
percent 46.08 / 13.05 / 59.13 | BALANCE amt 20,833.20.
*** HIS SHEET IS INTERNALLY INCONSISTENT: the third AMOUNT column is labelled "Total Amt" but
holds the BALANCE, while the third QTY column IS a genuine total. A report rendering both as
"total" matches his layout and is arithmetically wrong. That is the false pass. ***

START BY CLONING THE REPOS, THEN READ point_no=0, THEN READ platform.cc_queue.

================================================================================
=== ADDED 22 AUG - WHO DOES WHAT, AND WHAT IS WAITING ON RAJAT
================================================================================
*** CLAUDE CODE RUNS LOCALLY ON RAJAT'S LAPTOP WITH HIS OWN ACCESS. It manages websites,
Vercel, Supabase, git and the server. RAJAT IS NON-TECHNICAL AND THE RUNNER IS HIS HANDS.
DO NOT ROUTE A CREDENTIAL OR DASHBOARD TASK TO RAJAT MANUALLY WHEN THE RUNNER CAN DO IT. ***
Chat declines credential VALUES because a chat transcript is the wrong place for them
(E-72). That is a limit on CHAT, not a judgement about the runner.
UNCHANGED: chat never handles a credential value; the runner never prints one into
proof_of_work; neither weakens a security control to make a task pass. The runner
correctly refused to disable veridian-server-gate (E-115) and that judgement stands.

--- THE ONE THING THAT UNBLOCKS 17 POINTS ---
*** POINT 175. SEVENTEEN POINTS SIT BEHIND IT AND NOTHING ELSE BLOCKS THEM. ***
Nobody can log in to the demo org. Chat's TLD diagnosis (E-117) was DISPROVED by R29,
which created a valid-TLD projexa-ai.com account and reproduced the same "Database error
querying schema" 500. Chat then eliminated three more causes: the on_auth_user_created ->
handle_new_user trigger is clean, supabase_auth_admin grants are intact, zero custom auth
hooks exist.
*** NEXT TEST, FROM R29's OWN WORDING - "HAND-INSERTED Supabase Auth users cannot complete
password-grant login": CREATE THE USER THROUGH THE SUPABASE DASHBOARD UI (Authentication >
Users > Add user) OR THE ADMIN API, NOT BY SQL INSERT. The runner has that access. If
hand-insertion is the fault, the queue goes from 1 to 18. ***
If that fails too the fault is GoTrue-side - incomplete auth migration or project Auth
config. Record it and STOP. Do not repair the auth schema by hand.

--- FIVE THINGS WAITING ON RAJAT, FOUR ARE ONE SENTENCE ---
 1. THE LAYOUT RULING. Blocks 169 and 187 - the ENTIRE two-screen workstream - open since
    16 AUGUST. *** READ veridian-ui-kit commit 8f692af FIRST: "feat(shell): left working
    column, wide right ERP surface". A shell ALREADY EXISTS and matches neither MOCK1's
    narrow-left nor the 16 Aug wide-middle direction. The question may be moot. ***
    Answer: accept the shipped shell, or rebuild wide-middle.
 2. CHAIN LAYER, point 122 - say "defer". 33 phase-12 rows in the dead build_plan table.
 3. GPLv3, point 180 - chat reviewed it, NO GPL CODE EXISTS; every mention is a deliberate
    "no code copied" note. Open only: does Rajat want a lawyer to confirm? SEPARATE: no
    repo has a LICENSE file and all seven are PUBLIC. Pre-commercialisation.
 4. SITE INSTRUCTION FORM, point 166 - Sumeet must supply a blank copy, a filled example or
    a field list. May reduce to attaching a PDF to a variation.
 5. GO-LIVE, point 183 - the Vercel DATABASE_URL. THE RUNNER CAN DO THIS. Sequence matters:
    merge the honest health probe FIRST, then the value, then a FRESH DEPLOY - never a
    Redeploy, which reuses the old environment (M16).

--- THE UI/UX DESIGN IS AGREED. DO NOT REDESIGN IT. ---
platform.claude_log status='standing' holds M24, M24-A, M24-B, M24-C, M24-D: 30/70 panes,
Task Master left, ERP right, no rails, a full-width docked composer that IS the focal
surface and grows upward, the Mode > chain > step strip with the (x), history that LOADS
and never RUNS, the pre-submit confirmation list, re-entry from Task Master, and the
transient JUST CREATED band.
*** THREE BLOCKERS SIT AHEAD OF ANY UI WORK: E-119 (zero construction modules, so pills
resolve to nothing), E-120 (THE COMPOSER HAS NO SUBMIT PATH AT ALL - no onSubmit, no
/api/tasks in projexa, no /api/v1/projexa/tasks) and the four additive task columns.
BUILDING THE UI FIRST PRODUCES A BEAUTIFUL SURFACE THAT CANNOT SUBMIT ANYTHING. ***
COLOURS: use the ct- tokens. projexa's px-* classes are ALIASES onto them, NOT a fork -
chat got that wrong and withdrew it (E-118). Do not mass-rename 104 files.


================================================================================
=== M25 SUMMARY FOR THE HANDOUT - THE DIVISION OF ACCESS
================================================================================
*** RAJAT, VERBATIM 22 AUG: "you are chat, you dont handle passwords - thats accepted.
claude code - is in my laptop as a program installed, it handles everything, it has
access to everything, its not public. i am non techie and it does all work for me and
that has helped. i will continue using claude code in desktop for managing all my
websites, vercel, supabase, git, server etc as it can manage it. i cannot." ***

CHAT declines credential VALUES because a chat transcript is the wrong place for them
(E-72). THAT IS A LIMIT ON CHAT, NOT ON THE SYSTEM.
CLAUDE CODE is installed locally on Rajat's own machine, is not public, and carries his
own access. IT IS THE CORRECT TOOL for Vercel, Supabase, git, the server and the
websites. RAJAT IS NON-TECHNICAL. THE RUNNER IS HIS HANDS.

*** THE TEST BEFORE ASSIGNING ANYTHING TO RAJAT: is this a DECISION only he can make, or
an ACTION the runner could perform? IF IT IS AN ACTION, IT GOES IN THE QUEUE. ***
Chat breached this repeatedly and it has been corrected:
  point 183 (DATABASE_URL + fresh deploy) - was a Rajat task for days. NOW THE RUNNER'S.
  point 175 (create a working demo login) - was a Rajat task. NOW THE RUNNER'S, and it
    is the gate holding SEVENTEEN points.
  ".env needs two lines" - was written as a Rajat errand. RUNNER WORK.
GENUINELY RAJAT'S, AND ONLY THESE - DECISIONS, NOT ACTIONS:
  122 defer the chain layer | 169 + 187 the layout ruling | 180 whether to instruct a
  lawyer | 166 ask Sumeet for the site instruction form.

UNCHANGED AND ABSOLUTE:
 1. Chat never handles a credential value - not in a message, a note, or a cc_spec row.
    Presence is confirmed with grep -c, which returns a count and never a value.
 2. The runner never prints a credential into proof_of_work, cc_status or errors_hit.
 3. Neither weakens a security control to make a task pass. The runner refused to disable
    veridian-server-gate on a general go-ahead and was CORRECT (E-115) - a go-ahead for
    data writes is not a go-ahead for changing security posture.
 4. Chat still verifies independently. Delegating the hands never delegates the proof.
